stem: Mobile had 100,000 sessions, 8,000 of which added to cart, and 2,000 of those purchased. Desktop had 50,000 sessions, 6,000 of which added to cart, and 1,500 of those purchased. Where does mobile convert worse than desktop?

options.text: At add to cart only, since both turn 25% of their carts into purchases
At purchase only, since mobile turns fewer of its carts into orders
At both steps, since mobile's overall rate of 2% trails desktop's 3%
At neither step, since mobile had more purchases than desktop in total
